question_text: Outline how a relational database can support a venue’s display of tickets remaining for each event.
adaptation_rationale: Retain concrete relational data retrieval benefit instead of generic information-system taxonomy. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: Related event/seat/booking tables store current facts; queries retrieve unsold seats for the selected event to present current availability.

marking_points.criterion: Query retrieves remaining availability for display.
